content.short: Bushi is a high-octane competitive third-person hero shooter built to deliver fast-paced gameplay and on-chain asset integration for players.
content.description: Bushi is a competitive hero shooter that focuses on skill-based gameplay and high-quality graphics within the Web3 gaming space. Built on the Onenet platform, Bushi offers players a traditional gaming experience with the added benefits of blockchain-backed asset ownership. The game has collaborated with the Mantle Network to bring competitive tournaments and NFT rewards to the Mantle community, providing a high-performance gaming environment for both casual and pro players.
content.meta: Bushi is a high-octane competitive hero shooter with on-chain asset integration on Mantle. Discover Bushi on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
